name: Sales Tax Calculator API
description: Use this API to calculate sales tax, VAT, and GST where supported. Save transactions, record adjustments, submit batches, and check coverage. Each sales tax calculation response includes an outcome; check it before using the returned amounts. The API does not provide legal advice.
